Brainripper

Overview

Brainripper is a Wormface who recognises Kir as a Joon and invokes an ancient agreement between their peoples. Access to the depths and further information depend on tasks involving a necromancer and the Priest of Silence. His conversations give Kir a link to history that Suslanger’s human authorities do not provide. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Defending the Shelter and the ancient treaty

An imperial scout discovers the Shelter. After fighting the expedition, Khatul proposes placing Wormface bodies at the battlefield to conceal the brotherhood’s involvement. In the depths, Brainripper recognises Kir as a Joon and invokes an ancient treaty. He demands the death of a necromancer disturbing the caves before granting access. Later he calls Kir mentally and offers information for rescuing the Priest of Silence from the necromancers. His account of a human searching for Joon remains gives another lead, though he cannot say where that man now lives. The alliance is reciprocal and conditional, not a promise to answer every question. [5, 6, 1, 2, 7, 8, 3, 4]
